limitations: EIA annual crude-capacity records have no map coordinates and do not replace a facility/complex identity crosswalk or later operator status confirmations.
IIR process-unit and non-US inventories are retained source snapshots; there is no equivalent complete public global unit API.
Operator webpages and tariff publication indexes are checked for availability and change, not automatically interpreted as verified capacity, operating status or effective toll changes.
An unchanged old PDF does not establish that it is still the current filing; publication indexes and scheduled effective-date warnings are checked separately.
